defs.def: a formal statement of an opinion agreed on by a committee or a council, especially by means of a vote 决议；正式决定

ex.s: The draft resolution will be brought to the floor for debate at an MUN conference.
ex.t: 决议草案将在模拟联合国会议上提交大会辩论。

ex.s: For example: 1 Building more schools in rural areas to encourage more families to keep their children in full-time education; 2 Go online to find out more information about preparing a draft resolution.
ex.t: 例如：1 在农村地区建更多学校，鼓励更多家庭让孩子接受全日制教育；2 上网查找有关准备决议草案的更多信息。

ex.s: Bring your draft resolution to the floor for debate.
ex.t: 将你的决议草案提交会议讨论。

ex.s: Find out whether the class approve or veto the resolution, and what other solutions they suggest.
ex.t: 弄清全班同学是赞成还是否决这项决议，以及他们提出了哪些其他解决方案。

defs.def: the act of solving or settling a problem, disagreement, etc. （问题、分歧等的）解决，消除

ex.s: Moreover，the older you are，the more likely you will come to a resolution after an argument．This may be because more life experience usually leads to more defined priorities．You are more likely to distinguish between what matters and what does not．
ex.t: 此外，你年纪越大，争执后越可能达成和解。这也许是因为更多的生活阅历通常会带来更明确的是非轻重。你更有可能区分什么重要、什么不重要。

ex.s: Why is it that“the older you are， the more likely you will come to a resolution after an argument”？
ex.t: 为什么“你年纪越大，争执后越可能达成和解”？

ex.s: MUN, or Model United Nations, is an opportunity for students to learn about diplomatic relations and write a draft resolution to solve issues concerning the international community.
ex.t: MUN，即模拟联合国，是学生了解外交关系并撰写解决国际社会问题的决议草案的机会。

defs.def: the quality of being resolute or determined 坚定；坚决；有决心
a firm decision to do or not to do sth 决心；决定

ex.s: Contrary to popular doubt, resolutions made on I January are more effective for this reason.
ex.t: 与普遍的怀疑相反，出于这个原因，在1月1日下定的决心更有效。

ex.s: New Year resolutions are well received.

defs.def: the power of a computer screen, printer, etc. to give a clear image, depending on the size of the dots that make up the image 清晰度；析像；分辨率；解像度
